title: astragalus vesicarius var. pseudoglaucus
intro: Astragalus vesicarius var. pseudoglaucus, commonly known as Chinese milk vetch, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese milk vetch include reducing fever, alleviating cough, and treating respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
